updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.8.4  
 - Adds OKB EFB Tab layers MIZ (DCS Draw Layer) and SAM threats (live from the AWACS Threat tab) 
 - OKN Out fix FLT PLN Tab NAVLOG width handling 
 - OKB Out UI checkbox addition for Allow LAN Connection (Turns on LAN pipeline and requests to open OKB port for private connection only) 
 - OKB Out FLT PLN Tab AH-64D Apache DTC Handling And new module specific Comms Panel UI 
 - Redesign DTC import for all modules to feed a common OKB side conical collecter and allow easier render paths/ 
 - Refactor OKB Out to make long tern support and coding easier, break out CSS and JS code.
